correctness.rationale: Connected separable degree-four cover: the three nonzero Artin–Schreier characters have odd pole M, hence a single point P, genus g=3(M−1)/2, and fixed quotient breaks/genera. For λ=0, w=z+α²y gives w⁴+w=x^M and ord_P(w)=−M, so H(P)=<4,M> by genus equality. For λ≠0, ord_P(w)=−2D and u=y+c x^((M−D)/2)w (c²λ=1) has order −(3M−2D): the pole-order comparison is strict since M>D. The Apéry residues {0,2D,3M−2D,3M} modulo 4 have genus g, completing semigroup equality. Counting nongaps <g via cited characteristic-two Cartier lemma gives exact F_g counts, ray M=8s+5,D=6s+3 gives 4s+3 versus 3s+2. Independent finite ray/semigroup checks support algebra but not all M,D.
